item.title: Here Are Japan's Best-Selling Switch and Switch 2 eShop Games For 2025
item.description: Mario Kart World and Pokémon top the list.It’s once again that time of year where companies sum up all sorts of things about the year that was, and with this in mind, Nintendo’s Japanese branch has revealed the best-selling games on the Switch and Switch 2 eShop in 2025.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Arcade Archives Celebrates 500 Retro Releases With Special Commemorative Game
item.description: The classic Space Invaders returns.Last year in January, Hamster’s Arcade Archives series for the Switch and multiple other platforms reached 400 releases. Now, in an update at the end of 2025, it’s been officially confirmed that the retro-specialist has now hit 500 releases!Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: ICYMI: Stardew Valley - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Is Now Available, Will You Be Getting It?
item.description: The new version is now live.In case you missed it, following ConcernedApe’s status update last week, Stardew Valley – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is now officially available.This particular version comes loaded with mouse controls, four-player split-screen as well as eight-player online multiplayer. There’s also GameShare support for Switch and Switch 2 users, so players without a copy of the title can still join in on the farming fun.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "If Mario Starts To Show Up On PlayStation, That's The Apocalypse, Right?" - Ex-PlayStation Boss Thinks Console Exclusives Are Still Important
item.description: "If you do exclusives you can push every lever to 11 in that platform".We find ourselves in an unusual position when it comes to console exclusives these days.Once upon a time, titles like Halo, Forza, Death Stranding, and God of War would have been playable only on hardware produced by their respective owners. However, today, Microsoft is releasing its games on PS5, while Sony is happy for its leading lights to hit PC.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Opinion: I Finally Finished Ring Fit Adventure, And It Might Be Peak Nintendo?
item.description: I might just be tired.I must have some kind of record for Ring Fit, if not internationally (see: here), then at least for the West Midlands. I played 10 hours over the weekend, which probably sounds like a lot. I can confirm it was.You know those charity fundraisers of dancing for 24 hours or whatever? It wasn't that. All I raised was my knees (a lot), the Ring (nearly as much), and my cat towards the ring to try and get it to jump through (once, he didn't).Read the full article on nintendolife.
